tables-create-table.name: tables-create-table
tables-create-table.description: Create a new table, optionally with fields.

fields.description: The columns to create. Leave empty to create a table with no fields.

options.description: Comma-separated options, used only when Type is Single Select.

tables-delete-table.name: tables-delete-table
tables-delete-table.description: Delete a table and all of its records.

tables-create-records.name: tables-create-records
tables-create-records.description: Insert one or more new records to a table.

records.description: Advanced: provide records as a JSON array of objects keyed by field name, e.g. [{"Name":"John","Age":30}]. Use this when the table is selected dynamically (its columns are unknown at build time). When set, this overrides the Records form above.

records_ids.description: The IDs of the records to delete

tables-update-record.name: tables-update-record
tables-update-record.description: Update values in an existing record

record_id.description: The ID of the record to do the action on.

values.description: The values to update. Leave empty to keep current value.

tables-get-record.name: tables-get-record
tables-get-record.description: Get single record by its id.

record_id.description: The ID of the record to do the action on.

tables-find-records.name: tables-find-records
tables-find-records.description: Find records in a table with filters.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default no limit).

tables-clear-table.name: tables-clear-table
tables-clear-table.description: Delete all records from a table

tables-download-table.name: tables-download-table
tables-download-table.description: Export a table as a CSV file.

include_headers.description: Whether to include column headers as the first row of the CSV.

newRecord.name: newRecord
newRecord.description: Triggers when a new record is added to the selected table.

updatedRecord.name: updatedRecord
updatedRecord.description: Triggers when a record is updated in the selected table.

deletedRecord.name: deletedRecord
deletedRecord.description: Triggers when a record is deleted from the selected table.
